# 星际漫游表面纹理

Author: Solar System Scope / INOVE
Source: https://www.solarsystemscope.com/textures/
License: Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 International
https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/

Downloaded 2026-10-04 from `https://www.solarsystemscope.com/textures/download/2k_{name}.jpg`.
Names: mercury, venus_atmosphere, earth_daymap, mars, jupiter, saturn, uranus, neptune, moon.

Changes: resized to 1024 × 512 and encoded as WebP quality 84. Runtime CSS applies spherical limb shading and slight saturation reduction. Files are `assets/site-icons/cosmos-texture-{body}.webp`.

These maps are based on NASA imagery/elevation data and artist processing, not unmodified photographs. The source notes that some unmapped terrain is reconstructed and colors are enhanced. Venus uses the atmosphere map rather than depicting its surface through opaque clouds.

The Sun retains its original yellow gradient and does not use a photographic texture.

Only the existing cosmos theme's home planet/moon surface layers use these maps. No planet sizes, orbit paths, speeds, axis rotations, focus interactions, rings or horizon behavior were changed. The solarVoyage and globe themes are untouched.
